speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the exact location of your severe abdominal pain, how long you have been experiencing these symptoms, and if the pain radiates to your back or groin.

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old female. The patient presents with a 5-day history of severe abdominal pain and cramping, accompanied by nausea and vomiting. She reports pain with urination and also experienced burning pain during sexual intercourse 3 days ago. She mentions being sexually active with one male partner, using condoms inconsistently.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pelvic Inflammatory Disease (PID) with possible concurrent urinary tract infection.

Based on your age, history of inconsistent condom use, burning with urination, and dyspareunia, I am concerned about an ascending infection. Please return to the clinic immediately for a pelvic examination, urine analysis, and blood work to confirm the diagnosis and start treatment.
